channel.title: Holy City Sinner - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Holy City Sinner (holycitysinner.com)

item.title: Together SC and Clemson University Launch Internship Program to Strengthen South Carolina’s Nonprofit Workforce
item.description: Together SC, in partnership with Clemson University, is launching a new initiative designed to expand internship opportunities within South Carolina’s nonprofit sector.

item.title: Governor McMaster: Dedicate Over $1 Billion in New Money for Roads
item.description: In a preview of his soon to be released 2026 executive budget, Governor Henry McMaster today announced he will recommend the General Assembly appropriate an additional $1.1 billion in new money from the state budget to keep road projects moving

item.title: South Carolina Recognizes National Mentoring Month with Second Annual SC Mentors Advocacy Day
item.description: South Carolina proudly joins the nation in celebrating National Mentoring Month this January 2026, honoring the mentors and mentoring organizations across the state who are helping young people thrive.

item.title: Interdenominational Women’s Gathering in Lowcountry to Focus on Faith and Purpose
item.description: As the New Year begins, women from across the Lowcountry are invited to pause, reflect, and reconnect at a faith-centered gathering on Saturday, Jan. 17, 2026, from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m., at Oak Grove Family Life Worship Center

item.title: Cocktails for a Cause to Support College of Charleston Orchestra, Opera Programs
item.description: Harbour Club at WestEdge will host Cocktails for a Cause on Jan. 20, 2026, in preparation for the debut of the College of Charleston Orchestra and Opera Program in Boston this spring.

item.title: First Tee - Greater Charleston Accepting Applications for Award-Winning Golf and STEM Enrichment Program
item.description: Local nonprofit First Tee - Greater Charleston is accepting applications for their Pathfinder Immersion Program. Current 5th grade students are eligible to apply, now through February 27 for 2026 summer camp consideration.

item.title: Charleston Announces Direct Flight to Cancun via Breeze Airways’ First International Route
item.description: Just in time for winter escapes, Breeze Airways is launching its first-ever international flight, with nonstop service from Charleston to Cancun beginning Jan. 17, 2026.

item.title: BCLS Storytime Returning to All Locations
item.description: Berkeley County Library System (BCLS) invites parents and children ages *birth-5 years to return to all locations for Storytime through the week of April 20, 2026. *Additional ages are welcome!

item.title: Mermaids to Make a Splash at South Carolina Aquarium in February
item.description: Mermaids will bring waves of magic to the South Carolina Aquarium each weekend in February, offering guests of all ages a chance to experience marine mythology paired with ocean conservation.
